Looking at panels D and E, the myelin sheath length distributions for the isolated‑oligodendrocyte (fiber) cultures are compared to the neuron co‑culture. At day 7 the fiber distribution is shifted (excess short sheaths, different tail), but by day 14 the percent‑frequency and log‑length profiles overlap closely with the neuron co‑culture, indicating comparable sheaths. Hence the minimum time is 14 days.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
